title: Padded diagonal simulator
statement: For a function $\Phi : \mathbb{N} \times \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, a padded diagonal simulator consists of a finite Turing machine $W$ over the Boolean alphabet with the following property: for every time bound $T : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and every language $L \in \mathrm{DTIME}(T)$, there are natural numbers $A$ and $N_0$ such that, for every $n \ge N_0$, some binary string $x$ of length $n$ is computed by $W$ with output the indicator of whether $x \in L$, within $A\Phi(T(n),n)$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: For each sufficiently large $n$, existence of a length-$n$ input with the stated computation
